name: PDF text
description: Extract the text layer from a PDF. The attachment router pointed PDFs at 'pandoc:to-markdown', which has never existed — and pandoc cannot read PDF anyway — so every attached PDF fell through to 'saved as reference' with no text at all.

presets.label: PDF → text
presets.description: Keeps the page layout, which matters for tables and two-column books

presets.label: PDF → text (reading order)
presets.description: Ignores layout and follows the document's own order — better for flowing prose
